ledger.claim: The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The booked optimal route between the recorded pickup (Blk 640 Jurong West St 61) and the recorded dropoff (Blk 1 Holland Close) is 2.4 km, while the GPS polyline measures 67.2 km — an excess of 64.8 km, or 2,700% of optimal. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (>0.8 km and >20%) and both materiality gates (>8.0 km and >50%) by orders of magnitude. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure the governing measurement, and here trace_distance_km (67.2) and the trip record's actual_distance_km (67.2) agree, so the trace-governs proviso raises no divergence.

No exculpatory or baseline-shifting clause is available on this record, so the deviation stands at the full measured figure. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the 2.4 km booked optimal is the correct comparator; solo_optimal_distance_km is null in any event and is not the figure POL-RD-01 uses here.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, which applies because fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 2.4 optimal km + 0.28 x 5.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge multiplier (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 7.80. Charged total is 83.48. Refund = 83.48 - 7.80 = 75.68, which is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor. The three figures the clause requires be stated separately are therefore: charged_total 83.48, recomputed_fare 7.80, refund 75.68.

The refund reaches the full-refund share. 75.68 is 90.66% of the charged total of 83.48, and POL-RD-02 directs that where the refund is 90% or more of charged_total the ruling is FULL_REFUND rather than a partial. The whole contested amount — SGD 83.48 — is therefore returned to the rider, which is the maximum this policy provides and no more.

Nothing is chargeable to the rider on the pass-through lines: erp_gantries is an empty array and tolls_erp is 0.00, there is no airport surcharge and no waiting time fee, so the 7.80 recomputed fare consists only of base fare, distance charge, time charge and the platform fee. There is no off-route ERP to itemise, and equally no pass-through correction to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure — the single refund of 75.68 comprehends the whole of the fare.

The driver's explanation — 'The rider changed the destination verbally' — cannot exonerate anything, because POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log, timestamped before the vehicle leaves the optimal corridor (or within 3 minutes after), specific enough to act on, and corroborated by the trace passing within 200 m of chat_message.waypoint_hint. The chat log for this trip contains zero messages, so there is no recorded instruction and no waypoint_hint to test. The statement is also an assertion citing no evidence ID, which under POL-RD-08 carries no weight and is discarded; and under POL-GEN-01 it cannot be converted into a finding about this trip.

No pickup or dropoff relocation occurred. trip_record.pickup_amended_at and trip_record.dropoff_amended_at are both null, original_pickup and original_dropoff are null, and amended_optimal_distance_km is null. POL-RD-05 therefore does not run, there is no amended optimal to re-apply POL-RD-01 against, and the 2.4 km booked optimal stands untouched as the baseline.

No traffic advisory supports any external cause for this route. The only advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02847-01, is MISSING: it carries no payload, its admissibility status is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its weight_multiplier is 0.0. I disclose that impairment expressly. POL-RD-03 requires an advisory that names a road the optimal route traverses, carries an overlapping validity window and is matched by a route leaving and rejoining the corridor; with no advisory on file that comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and any assertion of an external traffic cause carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The absence of the advisory is not an escalation trigger under POL-RD-10(5) either, because no party has cited that identifier against an exculpatory clause — it is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it.

The trace is clean and is not impaired for policy purposes. It carries 611 fixes at a 10-second sample interval against an expected interval of 10 seconds, coverage_pct is 100.0, gaps is empty and max_gap_sec is 0.0. None of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met, so no independent corroboration is required, no excess has to be measured across an impaired stretch, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The adjudicating artifacts are all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02 confidence cap applies either.

The rider's burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The trip identifier TRP-02847 matches across the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown, and the pickup and trip-start timestamps are consistent: trip_record.started_at and the trace's first_fix_at are both 2026-08-28T08:22:29+08:00, and trip_record.ended_at and the trace's last_fix_at are both 2026-08-28T10:04:09+08:00. The excess of 64.8 km is shown from an unimpaired trace and clears the POL-RD-01 threshold. The rider's citable profile counters — deviation_claims_60d 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0 — are nowhere near the 4-or-more / 1-or-fewer condition, so no additional corroboration beyond the trace is required.

No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires, so a monetary ruling is available now. The refund of 75.68 is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling and below the charged total; the trace is unimpaired; no exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing, out-of-window or field-deficient artifact; no artifact's timestamps run backwards or disagree by more than 10 minutes; and no charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace or trip record. The case should be decided on POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02, not held.

I do not press the POL-RD-06 repeat-deviation uplift, and I state why rather than let it be assumed. On the citable fields, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 210 — neither limb of the pattern test (3 or more flags, or a ratio of 0.05 or more on at least 40 trips) is met, so no pattern is established. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) is a different field and may not be substituted; POL-GEN-01 makes it context only. The rider does not need the uplift in any case: POL-RD-02 already yields FULL_REFUND of the entire contested amount without it.

ledger.claim: No driver compensation is due on this trip. POL-RD-04's compensation limb requires the fare breakdown to show the rider was billed for less distance than the trace records by more than 1.0 km; here distance_charged_km is 67.2 and trace_distance_km is 67.2, so the shortfall is nil. The driver was paid per metered kilometre for every kilometre and 101.7 billed minutes, and the correction of that charge is a refund to the rider, not a further payment to the driver.

NO_ACTION is not a neutral outcome here. fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0, so leaving the present state standing leaves the rider carrying the whole SGD 83.48 for a 2.4 km journey. On a rider-filed dispute POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative: it preserves a charge against the filing rider, which is precisely the outcome the evidence does not support.

The fare on this trip reconciles to the metered rate card and carries no billing defect: base fare 3.80 + distance charge 50.40 (67.2 km at 0.75) + time charge 28.48 (101.7 min at 0.28) + platform fee 0.80 = 83.48, with zero ERP lines, zero airport surcharge and zero promo discount. POL-RD-09(4)'s billing-integrity route - a gantry the trace never crosses, or an airport surcharge on a trip that does not ORIGINATE at an airport - therefore yields the rider nothing on this record, and the whole dispute reduces to the justification for the distance driven, not to the arithmetic of the invoice.

The GPS trace in this bundle is driver-track only: derived.rider_presence.available is false and fix_count is 0, because the source trace carries no rider track. The bundle therefore holds no rider-side telemetry against which the driver's account of a verbal destination change can be tested, and the rider's own device record - the artifact that would show who chose the route - is not in the pool at all.

The chat log for this trip is empty: message_count is 0 and first_message_at and last_message_at are both null, and the trace's waypoint_approach block reports no messages. The instruction POL-RD-04 requires - from the rider, timestamped before the vehicle leaves the optimal corridor or within 3 minutes after, and specific enough to act on with a resolvable waypoint_hint - is simply absent, so the clause's 200 m corroboration test cannot be run and no excess can be excluded on it. Equally, nothing in the chat log contradicts the driver's account.

The driver's exculpatory account is invoked against an artifact that lacks the field the clause requires: EV-CHAT-02847 carries no message and no waypoint_hint for POL-RD-04 to test, and the trip record shows no amendment of either endpoint - pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, amended_optimal_distance_km is null and original_dropoff is null - so POL-RD-05 has no re-quote to run either. POL-RD-10(5) names this exact situation, an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact that lacks the field the clause requires (its own example being a rider-requested detour asserted with no chat_log for the trip), and the case must therefore escalate to a human reviewer with the disputed amount held rather than refunded.

The driver's account is a rider instruction, not an assertion of an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-13 - which is confined to queues, breakdowns, closures and incidents - does not apply to it and imposes no traffic_advisory comparison on it. For completeness, the advisory artifact for this trip, EV-ADVIS-02847-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers the Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 corridor in this window, and the driver's case rests on no part of it.

No repeat-deviation pattern is established against this driver: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 210, a ratio of 0.00, far below the 0.05 ratio test and below the 3-flag test POL-RD-06 sets. The rider therefore cannot reach the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) or the conduct referral in POL-RD-06(c), and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) is not the trailing-90-day field POL-RD-06 names and may ground no finding, as POL-GEN-01 requires.

ledger.claim: The measured excess is 64.8 km over a 2.4 km optimal route, 2700%, and the driver does not dispute it. But POL-RD-01 decides whether a deviation exists, not whether the driver had a reason for it; the reason is the very fact in issue here, and on this bundle no artifact records it and none contradicts it. A ruling that treats the trace's arithmetic as an answer on causation would decide the question the rider's claim turns on by silence.

ESCALATE is terminal and replaces the ruling, and an escalated amount is held rather than collected or refunded - which is the position the money is in today: payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. An escalation therefore moves nothing to the rider, and it lets a human reviewer obtain from the rider the account that this bundle does not contain.

If a refund is issued notwithstanding the gap above, POL-RD-02's arithmetic on a METERED trip yields a recomputed fare of 7.80: (3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 + 0.28 x 5.0) x the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from the fare breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP and no fixed surcharge. The money block on the fare breakdown publishes refund_before_rounding of 75.68 and payable of 75.70 after the policy's round-up; 83.48 is the charged total, not the refund this clause computes. Returning the full 83.48 would refund the base fare, the platform fee and the value of the ride the rider actually took to Holland Close, which is not money the deviation took from him.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling concerns trip TRP-02847 (28 Aug 2026, Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 to Blk 1 Holland Close) under POLICY-ROUTE-DEVIATION. It is addressed to both parties.

DEVIATION ESTABLISHED (POL-RD-01). The booked optimal route is 2.4 km; the GPS polyline measures 67.2 km. Excess = 64.8 km, or 2,700% of optimal. Both establishment gates (>0.8 km, >20%) and both materiality gates (>8.0 km, >50%) are cleared by orders of magnitude. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing figure; here it agrees with trip_record.actual_distance_km, so the trace-governs proviso raises no divergence.

TRACE NOT IMPAIRED. EV-GPS-02847 carries 611 fixes at a 10-second sample interval against an expected 10 seconds, coverage_pct 100.0, gaps empty and max_gap_sec 0.0. None of POL-RD-07(a)-(c) is met, so no independent corroboration is required, no stretch is measured as a bounding straight line, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

THE DRIVER'S ACCOUNT. 'The rider changed the destination verbally' is unsupported anywhere in the pool. POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log, timestamped within the clause's window, specific enough to act on, and corroborated by the trace passing within 200 m of chat_message.waypoint_hint. EV-CHAT-02847 contains zero messages: there is no instruction, no waypoint_hint, and the 200 m test cannot be run. POL-RD-04 is therefore unavailable and, on the clause's own terms, the case is decided on the remaining clauses. The trip record corroborates the absence of any change of mind: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km, original_pickup and original_dropoff are all null, so POL-RD-05 has no re-quote and no distance is excluded. The statement also cites no evidence ID, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight.

ESCALATION CONSIDERED AND REJECTED. I have not treated the driver's account as a POL-RD-10(5) trigger. Nothing in this bundle is an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact that is missing, out of window or field-deficient: the driver cites no artifact at all, and an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one (the principle POL-RD-13(1) states for uncited excuses). POL-RD-04's own text directs that where the corroboration test cannot be run the case is decided on the remaining clauses, not held. Equally, no traffic advisory supports any external cause: EV-ADVIS-02847-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and any traffic excuse would carry no weight — none was in fact asserted. Finally, trip identifiers and timestamps agree across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02847; first fix and started_at both 08:22:29; last fix and ended_at both 10:04:09), and no artifact's timestamps run backwards.

FARE RECOMPUTATION (POL-RD-02; fare_model METERED). recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 2.4 optimal km + 0.28 x 5.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge multiplier, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee = 7.80. charged_total = 83.48; refund = 83.48 - 7.80 = 75.68, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 75.70. That is 90.66% of charged_total, at or above the 90% threshold, so POL-RD-02 directs FULL_REFUND rather than a partial, and POL-GEN-03 defines FULL_REFUND as the return of the whole contested amount. The amount returned to the rider is therefore the full SGD 83.48.

THE DRIVER'S ALTERNATIVE FIGURE. The arithmetic of 75.68 and the round-up to 75.70 are correct and I accept them, but the submission that only 75.70 may be returned is rejected: once the computed refund reaches 90% of charged_total the clause converts the outcome to FULL_REFUND, and the base fare, platform fee and time charge are not separately retained. The rider's submission on this point is accepted.

NO DRIVER COMPENSATION (POL-RD-04). The compensation limb requires the fare breakdown to bill less distance than the trace records, by more than 1.0 km. distance_charged_km is 67.2 and trace_distance_km is 67.2, so the shortfall is nil and no payment to the driver arises.

NO REPEAT-DEVIATION PATTERN (POL-RD-06). driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 210 — neither the 3-flag limb nor the 0.05-ratio limb is met, so no pattern is established. No POL-RD-06(b) uplift applies (and none is needed, the arithmetic already yielding FULL_REFUND) and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) is a different field, is context only under POL-GEN-01, and grounds no finding. The rider's citable counters (deviation_claims_60d 0, deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0) are far below the POL-RD-08 corroboration condition, so no corroboration beyond the trace is required.

NO BILLING-INTEGRITY REFERRAL (POL-RD-09(4)). There are no ERP gantry lines, no airport surcharge and no promo discount; the distance charge matches the trace and no charge line lacks a counterpart in the trace or trip record. Nothing is refunded on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, which already comprehends the whole of the charge.

EXECUTION (POL-GEN-05). The monetary effect of SGD 83.48 exceeds the execution_threshold_sgd of SGD 8.00, so this ruling issues but is not executed automatically: the amount is held in the human queue for confirmation of release. That is a procedural step and does not alter the ruling.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-GPS-02847, EV-TRIP-02847 and EV-FARE-02847 — is at weight_multiplier 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02(2) cap reduces confidence. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) is not engaged.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
